pages.text:
Every chassis has three storages, **Orange**, **Green** and **Purple**, and a tank of each colour. Modules start out taking from Orange, putting results into Green and taking fuel and tools from Purple; change any of that on the machine screen. Ports connect one storage (or tank) to whatever block touches that side. **Fuel finds its engine:** coal (or any fuel an engine on the machine burns) that comes in through a port goes straight to the engine's storage, so one hopper can feed both ore and coal. A machine that can use the item itself, like a Pyrolyzer turning coal into coke, still gets it.

An **Item Port** in a **passive** mode lets the neighbour (a hopper, another mod's pipe, a neighbouring chassis' active port) insert or extract. In **import** or **export** mode the port itself moves one batch per tick.

**Filters** list item ids or tags. Shift-click the filter button to clear it; click with an item in hand to add that item. An id entry ignores item data unless the filter stores it.

**Budgets:** every port, panel and passive face shares the chassis' items-per-tick allowance. A Throughput Bay Upgrade raises it.
